headline: Approved recommendation that Susan Tyler recuse herself from vote on Chippanee Golf Course purchase.
summary: Susan Tyler asked for an advisory opinion about her property's proximity to the Chippanee Golf Course and her ability to vote on the City's purchase of the course. After an executive session, the board recommended that she recuse herself, and that recommendation was approved.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the March 11, 2026 Special Meeting, all in favor.

Recusal of Susan Tyler from vote on Chippanee Golf Course purchase
plain_text:
Ethics Board Committee      
 
 
 
City of Bristol 
BRISTOL, CONNECTICUT  06010 
 
ETHICS COMMITTEE 
SPECIAL MEETING 
MINUTES  
WEDNESDAY SEPTEMBER 2, 2026 
6:00 P.M. 
 
1. CALL TO ORDER: 
  
By:  Chairman Roger Chiasson    Time: 6:01 pm  Place:    City Hall  
           111 North Main Street 
           Meeting Room 1-2 
 
 NAME PRESENT ABSENT 
MEMBERS Roger Chiasson, Chairman X  
 Bruce Barton X  
 Byron Pierce X   
 Joan Cloutier  X 
 John Bellemare X  
 Kristen O’Donnell (Via Zoom) X  
 Eric Carlson  X 
    
STAFF Maria Theam, Recording Secretary  X  
 
The following were also in attendance:  Susan Tyler  
 
2. Approval of Minutes  
 
MOTION: To approve the minutes of the March 11, 2026 Special Meeting. 
 
BY:  John Bellemare     Seconded: Bruce Barton 
 
For:   All in favor 
Against: None 
Abstained: None 
 
3. Discuss and take any necessary action on request for advisory opinion.  
Susan Tyler appeared and explained her reasoning for requesting an advisory opinion with regards to her personal 
property’s proximity to the Chippanee Golf Course and her ability to vote on the purchase of the golf course by the City 
at the City Council Meeting next week.
Ethics Board Committee      
 
MOTION: To go into Executive Session at 6:15 pm.  
 
BY:  Bruce Barton     Seconded: Byron Pierce 
 
For:   All in favor 
Against: None 
Abstained: None 
 
Roger, Bruce, John, Kristen and Byron went into executive session.  They returned from executive session at 6:22 p.m. 
and resumed the meeting on the record.   Chairman Chiasson shared that it is the Board’s opinion that Ms. Tyler should 
recuse herself from the vote on the purchase of the Chippanee Golf Course by the City of Bristol at next week’s meeting. 
 
MOTION: To exit executive session and return to the special meeting at 6:22pm 
 
BY:  John Bellemare     Seconded: Byron Pierce 
 
For:   All in favor 
Against: None 
Abstained: None 
 
MOTION: To Approve the Recommendation of the Board that Ms. Tyler recuse herself from voting on the 
purchase of the Chippanee Golf Course. 
 
BY:  John Bellemare     Seconded: Byron Pierce 
 
For:   All in favor 
Against: None 
Abstained: None 
 
4. ADJOURNMENT 
MOTION: To adjourn at 6:25 P.M. 
 
BY:  John Bellemare                                                              Seconded: Bruce Barton  
  
For:   All in favor 
Against: None 
Abstained: None 
 
 
Respectfully submitted, 
 
Maria Theam, recording secretary
